algorithms.description: The signature algorithms a token may use; one family only.

allowInsecureHttp.description:
Permit plain HTTP beyond loopback to the configured issuer and to a
JWKS URI declared in configuration. TLS remains required unless the
operator explicitly accepts this transport risk.

audience.description: The audience every accepted access token must carry in `aud`.

issuer.description:
Exact issuer accepted in access-token `iss` claims, an absolute
`https` URL, or a plain `http` URL when `allowInsecureHttp` is set.

jwksSource.description:
Where the issuer's signing keys come from. Absent reads the issuer's
OpenID Connect discovery document.

maximumTokenLifetimeSeconds.description: The longest lifetime a token may carry, in seconds.

requiredScope.description:
The scope every token must carry to create a session. The creating
principal is the token's issuer, subject, and client.

AuditDestinationKind.description: The configured audit destination kind, as written in product configuration.

oneOf.description: One JSON line per entry on standard output, flushed per entry.

AuditDocument.description: The process-local audit destination and keyed-pseudonym secret.

hashKeyRef.description: Secret reference to the audit hash key.

ClaimQueryDocument.description: One claim a credential query asks for.

path.description:
The claims path: object member names from the credential root, 1 to 8.
A name may repeat along a path (`address`, `address`), so this is an
ordered list, not a set.

ClientIdentifierDocument.description: One client identifier. The `type` member names the choice.

oneOf.description:
`x509_san_dns`: the leaf certificate's DNS subject alternative name is
the public host. Requests are signed with the certificate's key (ES256).

certificateChainRef.description: The PEM certificate chain, leaf first, as a secret reference.

signingKeyRef.description:
The private JWK that signs request objects, as a secret reference.
It must be the leaf certificate's key.

oneOf.description:
`x509_hash`: the client identifier is the SHA-256 hash of the leaf
certificate. Requests are signed with the certificate's key (ES256).

certificateChainRef.description: The PEM certificate chain, leaf first, as a secret reference.

signingKeyRef.description:
The private JWK that signs request objects, as a secret reference.
It must be the leaf certificate's key.

oneOf.description:
`decentralized_identifier` with a `did:web` DID. The service serves the
DID document at `/.well-known/did.json`. Requests are signed with an
Ed25519 key (EdDSA).

did.description:
`did:web:` and the host of `publicBaseUrl`, with no port and no
path.

signingKeyRef.description:
The private Ed25519 JWK (`kty` OKP, `alg` EdDSA) that signs request
objects, as a secret reference.

oneOf.description:
`pre-registered`: the client identifier is the bare `clientId` a wallet
operator registers, with this service's `/v1/jwks` as the key set.
Requests are signed with an Ed25519 key (EdDSA).

clientId.description:
The client identifier as registered with the wallet operator. It
holds no `:`, which is what marks it as pre-registered.

signingKeyRef.description:
The private Ed25519 JWK (`kty` OKP, `alg` EdDSA) that signs request
objects, as a secret reference.

CredentialFormat.description: The only credential format the service requests.

claims.description:
The claims asked for, 1 to 64. Ask only for what the policy needs.
Absent, the query requests no selectively disclosable claim and the
wallet presents the credential with none (OpenID4VP 1.0 section 6.4.1);
an empty list is refused.

id.description: The query identifier the wallet keys its `vp_token` by.

vctValues.description:
The credential types (`vct`) the wallet may present for this query, 1
to 16.

EnvironmentSecretProviderConfig.description: The environment secret provider. It takes no settings.

EvidenceCredentialsDocument.description: The issuer of the Evidence service credential.

algorithms.description: The signature algorithms a token may use; one family only.

allowInsecureHttp.description:
Permit plain HTTP beyond loopback to the configured issuer and to a
JWKS URI declared in configuration. TLS remains required unless the
operator explicitly accepts this transport risk.

allowedClient.description: The one client allowed to read results: Evidence's service client.

audience.description: The audience every accepted access token must carry in `aud`.

issuer.description:
Exact issuer accepted in access-token `iss` claims, an absolute
`https` URL, or a plain `http` URL when `allowInsecureHttp` is set.

jwksSource.description:
Where the issuer's signing keys come from. Absent reads the issuer's
OpenID Connect discovery document.

maximumTokenLifetimeSeconds.description: The longest lifetime a token may carry, in seconds.

requiredScope.description: The scope the Evidence token must carry to read a result.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

root.description:
Absolute directory holding one file per secret. Each file must be a
regular file owned by the runtime user, mode 0400 or 0600, with exactly
one hard link.

JwksSource.description: Where a runtime obtains the OIDC issuer's signing keys.

oneOf.description: Read `jwks_uri` from the issuer's OpenID Connect discovery document.

Fetch the key set from this absolute `https` URI, skipping discovery.
A plain `http` URI is accepted on loopback for supervised local
development, and beyond loopback only when the issuer block sets
`allowInsecureHttp`.

Read the key set from a secret, for deployments without network access
to the issuer.

ListenerBind.description: Socket address the runtime listens on, written host:port with an IP address host ([addr]:port for IPv6).

ListenerConfig.description: The listener of a runtime that declares no TLS or exposure settings.

ListenerDocument.description: The listener a wallet and a portal reach.

maximumRequestBytes.description: The largest request body accepted, in bytes.

requestTimeoutMilliseconds.description: How long one request may take, in milliseconds.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

acceptedResponseEncryption.description:
The `enc` values of an encrypted authorization response the service
accepts and advertises.

clientIdentifier.description:
The client identifier requests under this policy use: the `id` of an
entry in `clientIdentifiers`.

id.description: The policy identifier a portal names when it creates a session.

trustedAuthorities.description:
Trusted authority hints applied to every credential query. Omit for a
wallet that does not support them.

evidenceReadBurst.description: The most result reads one Evidence client may make in a burst.

evidenceReadsPerMinute.description: Result reads per minute for one Evidence client.

responseBurstPerRequest.description: The most response attempts against one session in a burst.

responsesPerRequestPerMinute.description: Response attempts per minute against one session.

sessionCreationBurst.description: The most sessions one principal may create in a burst.

sessionCreationsPerPrincipalPerMinute.description: Sessions one principal may create per minute.

walletRequestBurst.description: The most wallet requests admitted in a burst.

walletRequestsPerMinute.description: Request object fetches per minute, across all wallets.

walletResponseBurst.description: The most wallet responses admitted in a burst.

walletResponsesPerMinute.description:
Wallet responses per minute across all sessions. Every attempt counts,
including those for unknown request identifiers.

ResponseEncryption.description: The accepted `enc` values of an encrypted authorization response.

SecretProvidersConfig.description:
The secret providers a runtime enables. A reference is resolved only by a
provider declared here: `secret:file/name` under `file.root`, and
`secret:env/NAME` only when `environment: {}` is present.

environment.description:
Enables `secret:env/NAME` references, read from the process
environment. Declared as an empty mapping: `environment: {}`.

file.description: Enables `secret:file/name` references, read from files under `root`.

SecretReference.description: An exact secret reference: secret:file/name, resolved under secretProviders.file.root, or secret:env/NAME, resolved only when secretProviders.environment is declared.

SessionsDocument.description: The bounds of the in-memory session store.

maximumHeldPresentationBytes.description:
The most presentation bytes the store holds across all sessions, from
the moment a response is accepted until its session ends or its result
expires. A response that would exceed it is refused with a retryable
503; the sessions already holding results are unaffected.

maximumLiveSessions.description:
How many sessions the store holds. A full store refuses new sessions
rather than forgetting live ones.

resultTtlSeconds.description:
How long an accepted presentation is held for Evidence to read, in
seconds.

sessionTtlSeconds.description:
How long a session waits for the wallet's response, in seconds. The
request object expires with it.

TrustedAuthorityDocument.description:
A trusted authority hint passed to the wallet for minimisation. The service
still decides trust itself.

TrustedAuthorityType.description: The trusted authority type; only `aki` is offered.

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host preserved as written, no user information, and no backslash, whitespace or control character. DNS case and equivalent IPv6 literals are permitted.

description:
The wallet protocol service runtime file: one deployment of the OpenID4VP
verifier front end for Evidence.

apiVersion.description: The format version of this file.

applicantTokens.description:
The issuer of the applicant tokens a portal presents to create a
session.

clientIdentifiers.description:
How the service identifies itself to a wallet: one or more client
identifiers, each named by a local id. Every policy names the one it
uses, and every identifier is used by at least one policy.

evidenceCredentials.description: The issuer of the Evidence service credential that reads a result.

listener.description: The listener a wallet and a portal reach.

metricsListener.description:
The optional operator-only metrics listener: a loopback or private
address the service listener does not use. Absent means no metrics
endpoint exists.

policies.description: What a portal may ask a wallet to present. At least one.

publicBaseUrl.description:
The public origin wallets reach this service at: a bare https origin
with no path, query, or fragment. The response URI and the request URI
are built from it. A trailing slash is removed.

secretProviders.description: The secret providers the `*Ref` members may name.

sessions.description: The bounds of the in-memory session store.
